//: The one list of what goes into the packed file, read by BOTH build.mjs and build.py. Order matters: each blob is its files concatenated in this order, in one scope. guard.js is first in pk-app so the error boundary is up before anything else runs; harden.js is last in pk-app so it can wrap what the others defined; ds.css is last in pk-css so the design system has the final word. pk-ast (the GENERATED font library and preloaded markups — tools/addfonts.py, tools/addmarkups.py) runs last, after the app is up.
